notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight token enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Knight.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
